card.name: Linking words after change or exposure terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (at, with, until) right after a verb or noun of change or exposure, such as 'increased', 'decreases' or 'exposure in humans', just before the thing it depends on or the threshold.

modes.label: Change with a factor
modes.description: 'with' after increase or decrease verbs, introducing what the change tracks.
modes.example: clearance of telavancin increased<< with>> increasing ultrafiltration rate

modes.label: Exposure at recommended dose
modes.description: 'at' after 'exposure in humans' in animal reproduction statements.
modes.example: 2.5 to 20 times the exposure in humans<< at>> the recommended dose, based on C max

modes.label: Threshold word
modes.description: 'until' after 'accumulation occurs', before a clearance cutoff.
modes.example: No significant accumulation of atenolol occurs<< until>> creatinine clearance falls below 35
